messages:
mia: FYI seeing redwoodctl login fail in our CI when config dir is a symlink into the workspace. installer treats it as missing.

mia: repro (alpine image):
```
mkdir -p /home/runner/.config
ln -s /workspace/dotfiles/redwood /home/runner/.config/redwood
redwoodctl login --non-interactive
```

mia: error: "failed to find config dir: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/redwood not found"

samir: CI often has XDG_CONFIG_HOME unset or HOME=/root; we should fallback to $HOME/.config and follow symlinks.

jen: which redwoodctl version? installer vs tarball differ.

mia: 0.14.3 from apt and tarball mirror, same behavior.

samir: workaround: export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/workspace/dotfiles or set REDWOODCTL_CONFIG=/workspace/dotfiles/redwood before login.

mia: that works. installer does an Lstat check that fails on symlinked dirs in workspace.

jen: can you paste ls -la?

mia: ```
$ ls -la /home/runner/.config
total 8
drwxr-xr-x 2 runner runner 4096 Mar 1 12:00 .
drwxr-xr-x 22 runner runner 4096 Mar 1 11:59 ..
lrwxrwxrwx 1 runner runner 28 Mar 1 11:59 redwood -> /workspace/dotfiles/redwood
```

samir: installer should use os.Stat to follow symlinks and verify read perms. i'll open a tiny PR.

mia: another CI job hung during login when /etc/passwd lacked the runtime user entry (HOME empty). spinner never progressed until timeout. default HOME fallback would help.

jen: filing QA ticket to add smoke tests for our common CI bases (alpine, debian-slim, gh-runner).

devops-bot: CI artifact uploaded: https://ci.internal/1287/artifacts (job 1287)

samir: i'll target fix for rc/0.15.0, add repro to devex smoke-run, and document REDWOODCTL_CONFIG / XDG_CONFIG_HOME for CI.

mia: thanks! :thumbsup:

jen: please drop the minimal reproducer script in the issue so QA can toggle it.

mia: will add Dockerfile + script in the issue comment with job link.
